info.name: ParkirPintar — Demo Scenarios
info.description:
End-to-end demo collection untuk Smart Parking Marketplace.

Tiap folder = 1 skenario demo dan bisa dijalankan urut via Collection Runner. Test scripts otomatis chain variable (reservation_id, invoice_id, payment_id, jwt_token) ke environment.

**Prasyarat:**
- Semua service running (gateway :8080, reservation :9091, billing :9092, payment :9093, notification, postgres, redis, nats)
- Import `local.postman_environment.json`
- Run "00 — Auth › Get Dev Token" sekali untuk dapat JWT (kalau AUTH_PASSTHROUGH_NO_TOKEN=false)

**Variable conventions:**
- `{{baseUrl}}` = http://localhost:8080
- `{{driver_id}}` = uuid dummy (default di env)
- `{{jwt_token}}` = di-set otomatis oleh dev-token request
- `{{reservation_id}}`, `{{invoice_id}}`, `{{payment_id}}` = di-set by test scripts
- `{{idempotency_key}}` = di-generate by pre-request script saat dibutuhkan

exec: // Auto-generate Idempotency-Key kalau request butuh dan belum di-set

item.name: 00 — Auth
item.description: Issue JWT untuk Bearer token. Endpoint hanya aktif saat APP_ENV != prod.

item.name: 01 — Happy Flow: AUTO Payment
item.description:
Driver dengan saldo wallet — invoice ISSUED → auto-charge → PAID tanpa step manual.

Urutan: Availability → Create (AUTO) → Check-in → Check-out → Verify Invoice PAID.

exec: // Fresh idempotency key untuk request ini
// Beri waktu auto-pay subscriber + worker NATS untuk process

item.name: 02 — Happy Flow: MANUAL Payment (QRIS)
item.description:
Driver tanpa saldo — invoice ISSUED, driver call CreatePayment → scan QRIS → webhook → PAID.

Urutan: Create (MANUAL) → Check-in → Check-out → Get Invoice (ISSUED) → CreatePayment → GetPayment → (Webhook simulasi di folder 13).

item.name: 03 — Expired Flow
item.description:
Driver bikin reservation tapi gak check-in dalam holdDuration (default 1h). ExpiryWorker auto-set state=EXPIRED + apply no-show penalty 5000 IDR.

**Demo tip:** set `RESERVATION_HOLD_DURATION=30s` di .env.local supaya cepat lihat efek.

item.name: 04 — Overnight Stay
item.description:
Driver check-in pagi, check-out keesokan harinya. Pricing engine charge OVERNIGHT 20000 IDR flat (bukan hourly multiplier).

**Demo tip:** untuk lihat efek tanpa nunggu real 24h, jalankan di staging dengan TZ override atau sentuh DB checkin_at langsung.

item.name: (Manual step) Backdate checkin_at via DB — see README

exec: console.log('Run di postgres untuk demo overnight:');
console.log("UPDATE reservation.reservation SET checkin_at = NOW() - INTERVAL '12 hour' WHERE id = '{{reservation_id}}';");

item.name: 05 — Cancel After CONFIRMED (booking fee charged)
item.description: Per ADR-0014: cancel SETELAH state=CONFIRMED tetap charge BOOKING_FEE 5000 IDR (bukan VOID). Beda dari cancel saat PENDING (full void).

item.name: Get Invoice (expect ISSUED with BOOKING_FEE only)
06 — Manual Until Blocked (overdue + driver block)
item.description:
MANUAL invoice tidak dibayar dalam grace period (default 15m, override `BILLING_OVERDUE_GRACE=30s` untuk demo). Worker mark invoice OVERDUE → driver di-block dari booking baru.

Urutan: Create MANUAL → Check-in/Out → Skip pay → Wait grace → Verify OVERDUE → Try book #2 (rejected).

exec: console.log('TIP: Use folder 02 Check-in + Check-out as standalone, atau jalankan SQL UPDATE state langsung');

item.name: 07 — Idempotency
item.description: Same Idempotency-Key dikirim 2× → response identik (sama reservation_id). Stripe-style server-side dedup.

item.name: 08 — One Driver, One Active Reservation (RES-031)
item.description: Driver A bikin reservation #1 (CONFIRMED). Belum check-out. Coba booking #2 → reject dengan error driver_has_active_reservation. Setelah cancel atau check-out baru bisa book lagi.

item.name: 09 — User-Selected Spot Mode
item.description: Driver list spots per lantai (filter floor + vehicle_type), pilih spesifik, kirim CreateReservation dengan mode=USER + spot_id.

item.name: 10 — Concurrent Booking (race condition)
item.description:
**TIDAK bisa demo 100% via Postman tunggal** — perlu eksekusi paralel. Ada 2 cara:

**Cara A — Postman Collection Runner** dengan `Iterations=2` dan `Delay=0` di endpoint ini, lihat 1 sukses + 1 gagal.

**Cara B — bash one-liner (paling reliable):**
```bash
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/v1/reservations \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H "Idempotency-Key: race-$i-$(date +%s%N)" \
    -d '{"driver_id":"d-'$i'","plate_no":"B'$i'","vehicle_type":"CAR","mode":"USER","spot_id":"<SPOT>","payment_mode":"AUTO"}' &
done
wait
```
Hanya 1 yang return 200, sisanya 409.

item.name: 11 — Rate Limit Burst
item.description: Heavy tier (POST /v1/reservations) default 5 RPS, burst 10. Run via Collection Runner dengan `Iterations=15` `Delay=0` — yang ke-11+ kena 429 Retry-After.

exec: console.log('Iter', pm.info.iteration, '→', code, '| remaining=', remaining, '| retry-after=', retryAfter);

item.name: 12 — Health & Readiness
item.description: Probe gateway + lihat dependency status di /readyz response JSON.

item.name: 13 — Webhook Simulation (Midtrans)
item.description:
Simulasi push notification Midtrans untuk MANUAL invoice → status payment SUCCESS, invoice PAID.

**Mode test:**
- Mock mode (`PAYMENT_MOCK_MODE=true`): signature TIDAK di-verify, body apa saja diterima.
- Live mode: signature SHA-512 dari `order_id+status_code+gross_amount+server_key`. Lihat README untuk generate.

exec: // Hanya valid kalau PAYMENT_MOCK_MODE=false. Mock mode bakal 200.
